Fleet Management System

FleetAI was founded with a single mission: to make fleet management smarter, safer, and more profitable for every trucking operation in America. We combine real-time GPS tracking, AI-powered dashcams, ELD compliance tools, and predictive analytics into one seamless platform — trusted by over 2,000 fleet operators to keep their trucks moving and their drivers safe, from coast to coast.

Building the Connected
Fleet Ecosystem

We built FleetAI to connect every part of your trucking operation into one intelligent platform. From dispatch and route planning to driver communication and maintenance scheduling, our system brings real-time visibility to your entire fleet. With over 120 integrations and an open API, FleetAI works seamlessly with the ELDs, telematics devices, and accounting tools you already use — so you spend less time on spreadsheets and more time growing your business.

Our Commitment to Fleet
Safety & Efficiency

Every feature we build starts with one question: does this help fleet operators run safer, more efficient operations? From the hardware in the cab to the software in your office, everything we do is guided by these core principles:

  • Real-Time Fleet Visibility
  • Driver Safety First
  • Predictive Maintenance
  • FMCSA Compliance Built-In
  • 24/7 Fleet Support
  • Continuous Innovation
